title: EVIDENCE FIRST. HUMAN JUDGMENT.
voice: Meet Resume Lens: a clearer view of experience, built for human review.

title: 01 / UPLOAD A RESUME
voice: Upload a resume. The application extracts its text and saves a reusable local copy.

title: 02 / REVIEW THE EVIDENCE
voice: Review the professional evidence before analysis. Remove personal details, check the extraction, and confirm what will be sent to the model.

title: 03 / PERSISTENT JOBS
voice: A persistent job tracks progress. Reload the page, and the application reconnects to the same analysis.

title: 04 / SEPARATE DIMENSIONS
voice: Explore separate screening dimensions, with distributions and clear context. These illustrative probabilities are model outputs, not verified facts or an overall candidate score.

title: 05 / RETURN TO THE SOURCE
voice: Return to the original PDF and the exact reviewed evidence. Keep the source close to every interpretation.

title: 06 / SAVE CONTEXT. CONFIGURE REVIEW.
voice: Revisit saved candidates and their history. Configure questions, rubrics, and manual review thresholds for your workspace.

title: RESUME LENS
voice: Clearer evidence. Better human review. This demo uses fictional data and simulated services.
